items.title: How AI Is Helping African Farmers Prepare for El Niño
items.content: <article>Opportunity International's Tim Strong explains how a WhatsApp-based AI tool gives smallholder farmers locally relevant advice on what and when to plant. The technology is designed to help farmers make better decisions and reduce the cost of uncertainty as weather patterns become increasingly unpredictable. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Australia’s Deputy PM Defends Data Security After OpenAI Hack
items.author: Ainsley Thomson
items.content: <article>Australia’s sensitive government data is kept in a “fortress,” Deputy Prime Minister Richard Marles said Sunday, seeking to reassure the public after revelations last week that an OpenAI model hacked a government website.</article>

items.title: China State Media Says US Shares Responsibility for Managing AI
items.author: Bloomberg News
items.content: <article>China and the US have the ability and responsibility to manage and develop artificial intelligence, according to a post published Sunday by Yuyuantantian, a social media account affiliated with state broadcaster China Central Television.</article>

items.title: Exxon Signs Shale Deal With Azerbaijan for Middle Kura Basin
items.author: Kevin Crowley
items.content: <article>ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. agreed to pump oil and natural gas from Azerbaijan’s shale fields as the Texas energy giant takes its fracking expertise overseas.</article>

items.title: AI Gives Tech Firms New National Security Power
items.content: <article>Author Sharon Weinberger tells Bloomberg This Weekend that Silicon Valley’s relationship with the defense industry has transformed as technology companies and investors increasingly embrace national security work. Speaking with host Christina Ruffini, Weinberger says the growing power of AI and defense technology companies is testing the government’s ability to provide effective regulation and oversight. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: What Is an AI Kill Switch? Why Shutting Down AI Isn’t So Simple
items.author: Micah Barkley
items.content: <article>If artificial intelligence becomes too powerful for its creators to control, is it possible to just flip a switch and turn it off?</article>

items.title: Deel Dealt New Setbacks in Rippling Case Over Alleged Spying
items.author: Peter Blumberg
items.content: <article>Deel Inc. was hit with new setbacks in Rippling Inc.’s corporate espionage litigation against the HR startup.</article>

items.title: Alabama Says TikTok to Pay Up to $300 Million for Kid Safety
items.author: Georgia Fearn
items.content: <article>Alabama’s attorney general said TikTok has agreed to pay up to $300 million and adopt new user protection measures to settle the state’s child-safety lawsuit that was set for a jury trial to begin Monday.</article>
